svg.desc: Four-panel summary of Claims LA-53 through LA-55 and 98 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems (1463 Linux bwrap fleet): (A) Official 16-environment ARC-AGI-3 Landmark-Serialized Iterated Width SIW(2) + Two-Bank 8 KB System-0 LUT6 vault (9/113 levels across 7 games, mean RHAE 2.252, 0 breaker trips); (B) End-to-end sharded JouleBit-LUT6 + EntroMCU-28 speculative streaming on real prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B on Apple M3 Ultra 256 GB across Cold Wave-1 and Warm Wave-2 prompts at 100.0% greedy parity; (C) Cross-silicon Window 19 telemetry across Jetson AGX Thor DC shunt measured_j, AMD Zen 5 RAPL reported_j, and Apple M3 Ultra reported_j; and (D) Zero-DSP48E1 Artix-7 XC7A200T openXC7 gateware, 14.77 KB 14-export lut6_core.wasm, and 98 six-kernel theorems.
